stage: analysis design amendment fixed before new computed results; existing v11 data and results already known; not preregistered
baseline_policy: all six single-feature directions reported; no outcome-based best-baseline selection; charge is residue-count proxy ignoring H, termini, stereochemistry and chemistry; no learned baseline fitted
intervals: pointwise exploratory percentile; paired common block draws; >=5 contributing blocks and >=95% valid; omit degenerate; no multiplicity correction or significance labels
ties: expected label-blind fractional allocation within equal-score tier; AUROC half-credit; all methods share members, budget and labels
family_estimand: equal-family average of within-family AUROCs among families with both endpoint classes; all source families and exclusion reasons reported; singleton/free groups do not produce within-family discrimination; frozen dependence-block bootstrap
camps: minimum-branch score only a supplementary ranking extension; not eligible for q-based selection
honest_split: random partition of global dependence-group IDs; common across all models/policies; no endpoint labels used for partition; no group or exact-string overlap; held-source groups purged first
thresholds: all unique q=max(p,1-p) observed in selection subset, include equality; maximize original-source-balanced coverage, lowest threshold at tie; held and internal-validation labels not used
support_control_reason: compare per_source_supported against mixture_source_support to isolate adding source-risk constraints without confounding added source-support minima; mixture_original preserves published target as a separate reference
honest_evaluation: selection subset, independent groups within same five development sources, and untouched held source; evaluate frozen thresholds without refitting on validation
repeat_distributions: same held candidates reused across random development partitions; quantiles and ranges describe split sensitivity, are NOT confidence intervals or independent external replications
no_feasible_rule: retain explicit unavailability; do not fill with q=.95, use labels to rescue, or silently remove sources
output_policy: fresh directories; no original overwrite; smoke outputs cannot be submitted as formal results
